text.tspan: Each relay interrupts only the hot line to its pair of bulbs; neutral runs straight to the bulbs.
Mains side: 14 AWG, grounded metal enclosure, breaker sized for the 12.6 A total.
Keep it physically apart from the 3.3 V wiring.
Signals are shown as net labels: a tag on an ESP pin connects
to the tag of the same name on the peripheral.
Staged thermostat: 1, 2, or 3 relays on depending on how far
below the setpoint the room is. 2 °F deadband, 15 s minimum
on/off per bank, wear leveling by cycle count and runtime.
The encoder button uses the internal pull-up. Firmware in
